			# 结算B-5：叙利亚战败白和，以色列割取幼发拉底河以西的叙利亚领土
			# 州清单沿用 mew.23/25/26：184、185、186、571、188、189、190、566、575、561、191、994、192
			# 胜者判定：FROM = 胜者，必须是以色列赢下这场战争才结算
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_global_flag = MEW_sixth_war_ongoing
						has_global_flag = MEW_israel_victory
					}
					has_global_flag = MEW_interim_settlements
					FROM = { original_tag = ISR }
					ROOT = { original_tag = SYR }
					ROOT = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ISR_settled_SYR } }
				}
				ISR = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_war_with = SYR }
						white_peace = SYR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 184 = { is_owned_by = SYR } }
					184 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 185 = { is_owned_by = SYR } }
					185 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 186 = { is_owned_by = SYR } }
					186 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 571 = { is_owned_by = SYR } }
					571 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 188 = { is_owned_by = SYR } }
					188 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 189 = { is_owned_by = SYR } }
					189 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 190 = { is_owned_by = SYR } }
					190 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 566 = { is_owned_by = SYR } }
					566 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 575 = { is_owned_by = SYR } }
					575 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 561 = { is_owned_by = SYR } }
					561 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 191 = { is_owned_by = SYR } }
					191 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 994 = { is_owned_by = SYR } }
					994 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 192 = { is_owned_by = SYR } }
					192 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				ROOT = { set_country_flag = ISR_settled_SYR }
				set_global_flag = skip_default_capitulation
				set_global_flag = MEW_isr_peaced_syr
			}
			# 结算B-5b：叙利亚反对派战败白和，其在幼发拉底河以西的控制区归以色列
			# 胜者判定：FROM = 胜者，必须是以色列赢下这场战争才结算
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_global_flag = MEW_sixth_war_ongoing
						has_global_flag = MEW_israel_victory
					}
					has_global_flag = MEW_interim_settlements
					FROM = { original_tag = ISR }
					ROOT = { original_tag = FSA }
					ROOT = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ISR_settled_FSA } }
				}
				ISR = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_war_with = FSA }
						white_peace = FSA
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 184 = { is_owned_by = FSA } }
					184 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 185 = { is_owned_by = FSA } }
					185 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 186 = { is_owned_by = FSA } }
					186 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 571 = { is_owned_by = FSA } }
					571 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 188 = { is_owned_by = FSA } }
					188 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 189 = { is_owned_by = FSA } }
					189 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 190 = { is_owned_by = FSA } }
					190 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 566 = { is_owned_by = FSA } }
					566 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 575 = { is_owned_by = FSA } }
					575 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 561 = { is_owned_by = FSA } }
					561 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 191 = { is_owned_by = FSA } }
					191 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 994 = { is_owned_by = FSA } }
					994 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 192 = { is_owned_by = FSA } }
					192 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				ROOT = { set_country_flag = ISR_settled_FSA }
				set_global_flag = skip_default_capitulation
			}
			# 大以色列的最终判定移到 on_daily（文件末尾），
			# 因为白和退出战争不会触发 on_capitulation，投降事件里的判定会漏掉领土变更
			# ===== 反伊战争结算：伊朗战败，巴列维王朝复辟 =====
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = MEW_iran_war_ongoing
					ROOT = { original_tag = PER }
				}
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							original_tag = ISR
							original_tag = USA
							original_tag = SAU
							original_tag = UAE
							original_tag = KUW
							original_tag = QAT
							original_tag = BHR
							original_tag = OMA
						}
						has_war_with = PER
					}
					white_peace = PER
				}
				set_global_flag = skip_default_capitulation
				clr_global_flag = MEW_iran_war_ongoing
				set_global_flag = MEW_pahlavi_restored
				PER = {
					kill_country_leader = yes
					set_politics = {
						ruling_party = nationalist
						elections_allowed = no
					}
					start_politics_input = yes
					# 24 号政党指数为 Monarchist（君主派），令其垄断民意
					set_variable = { party_pop_array^23 = 1 }
					set_variable = { ruling_party = 23 }
					startup_politics = yes
					create_country_leader = {
						name = "Reza Pahlavi II"
						picture = "reza_pahlavi_shah.dds"
						ideology = Monarchist
						traits = {
							nationalist_Monarchist
							king
							geopolitical_thinker
							capable
						}
					}
				}
				news_event = { id = mew.32 }
			}
			# 结算B-6：其余阿拉伯/抵抗之弧参战方（阿尔及利亚、利比亚、黎巴嫩政府、伊拉克、伊朗）
			# 这五国没有割地设计，只退出战争；必须打上 skip_default_capitulation，
			# 否则会走默认投降流程（和平会议/条件性和约的 AI 全额傀儡），出现“以色列赢了自己却变傀儡”的结果
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = MEW_sixth_war_ongoing
					has_global_flag = MEW_interim_settlements
					country_exists = ISR
					ROOT = {
						OR = {
							original_tag = ALG
							original_tag = LBA
							original_tag = LEB
							original_tag = IRQ
							original_tag = PER
						}
					}
					# 只处理真正以以色列一方为胜者的投降；旧写法 ISR = { has_war_with = ROOT }
					# 会把阿尔及利亚等国的无关战争（如对邻国的战争）也纳入 MEW 结算并跳过其默认和约
					FROM = {
						OR = {
							original_tag = ISR
							is_in_faction_with = ISR
						}
					}
					ROOT = { has_country_flag = MEW_belligerent }
					ROOT = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ISR_settled_by_isr } }
				}
				ISR = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_war_with = ROOT }
						white_peace = ROOT
					}
				}
				ROOT = { set_country_flag = ISR_settled_by_isr }
				set_global_flag = skip_default_capitulation
			}
			# ===== 第四次起义（isrwar 链）结算：以色列战败，接受两国方案 =====
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = third_intifada
					ROOT = { original_tag = ISR }
				}
				set_global_flag = skip_default_capitulation
				ROOT = {
					country_event = { id = isrwar.15 }
				}
			}
			# ===== 墨西哥毒枭战争结算：毒枭战败，被联邦政府吞并 =====
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = MEX_mexican_cartel_war_global
					ROOT = {
						OR = {
							original_tag = SLA
							original_tag = TRC
							original_tag = TAM
						}
					}
					FROM = { original_tag = MEX }
				}
				FROM = {
					white_peace = ROOT
					annex_country = {
						target = ROOT
						transfer_troops = no
					}
				}
				set_global_flag = skip_default_capitulation
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { country_exists = SLA }
						NOT = { country_exists = TRC }
						NOT = { country_exists = TAM }
					}
					MEX = {
						country_event = { id = mexico.12 }
					}
				}
			}
			# ===== 墨西哥毒枭战争结算：联邦政府战败，毒枭接管全国 =====
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = MEX_mexican_cartel_war_global
					ROOT = { original_tag = MEX }
					FROM = {
						OR = {
							original_tag = SLA
							original_tag = TRC
							original_tag = TAM
						}
					}
				}
				clr_global_flag = MEX_mexican_cartel_war_global
				set_global_flag = MEX_mexican_cartel_war_over_global
				FROM = {
					country_event = { id = mexico.12 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# ===== 第六次中东战争最终判定（每日兜底）=====
	# 白和退出战争不会触发 on_capitulation，若只在投降事件里判定，
	# 就会出现“以色列宣布大以色列、很多地方却并没有吞”的情况。
	# 这里在所有参战方退出战争后强制执行领土变更。
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			# ===== 约旦：主要战线推进完毕后，以色列主动宣战 =====
			# 中间不再逐国结算，故以「以色列已控制加沙 209 / 西岸 208 / 西奈 213」作为判据；
			# 宣战后由终局收尾统一处理约旦诉求州（210/211/212），不再依赖单国投降旗标
			if = {
				limit = {
					ROOT = { original_tag = ISR }
					has_global_flag = MEW_sixth_war_ongoing
					has_global_flag = MEW_war_declared
					has_global_flag = MEW_coalition_joined
					NOT = { has_global_flag = MEW_israel_victory }
					NOT = { has_global_flag = MEW_settlement_done }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = ISR_war_on_JOR_started }
					country_exists = JOR
					NOT = { has_war_with = JOR }
					# 中间不再逐国结算，改用「加沙/西岸/西奈已被以色列控制」作为主要战线推进完毕的判据
					ISR = {
						controls_state = 209
						controls_state = 208
						controls_state = 213
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = ISR_war_on_JOR_started
				declare_war_on = {
					target = JOR
					type = annex_everything
				}
				JOR = {
					set_country_flag = MEW_belligerent
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					ROOT = { original_tag = ISR }
					has_global_flag = MEW_sixth_war_ongoing
					# 门槛：必须确实开过战（mew.0 宣战 + mew.6 阿拉伯联军介入），
					# 防止第 0 天（mew.6 尚未触发）或战败后误触大以色列结算
					has_global_flag = MEW_war_declared
					has_global_flag = MEW_coalition_joined
					NOT = { has_global_flag = MEW_israel_victory }
					NOT = { has_global_flag = MEW_settlement_done }
					country_exists = ISR
					# 大以色列判定：以色列实际控制“全部诉求州”，不再用“与全部参战方无战争”口径
					# 先要求 ISR 已对约旦宣战（保证“先宣战、后判定”的顺序，否则 210/211/212 永远拿不到）
					has_country_flag = ISR_war_on_JOR_started
					# 加沙 209 / 约旦河西岸 208 / 西奈 213
					# 约旦 210 阿曼、211 扎尔卡、212 南约旦
					# 幼发拉底河以西 13 州：184、185、186、571、188、189、190、566、575、561、191、994、192
					ISR = {
						controls_state = 209
						controls_state = 208
						controls_state = 213
						controls_state = 210
						controls_state = 211
						controls_state = 212
						controls_state = 184
						controls_state = 185
						controls_state = 186
						controls_state = 571
						controls_state = 188
						controls_state = 189
						controls_state = 190
						controls_state = 566
						controls_state = 575
						controls_state = 561
						controls_state = 191
						controls_state = 994
						controls_state = 192
					}
				}
				# ===== 终局一次性结算（MEW 参战方，仅执行一次）=====
				# 顺序：① 对全部 MEW 参战方白和 → ② 诉求州转州 → ③ 补核心 → ④ 吞并残余实体 → ⑤ 置旗标
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						has_war_with = ISR
						has_country_flag = MEW_belligerent
					}
					white_peace = ISR
				}
				# 诉求州：加沙 209、约旦河西岸 208、西奈 213、约旦 210/211/212、幼发拉底河以西 13 州
				if = {
					limit = { 209 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					209 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 208 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					208 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 210 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					210 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 211 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					211 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 212 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					212 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				# 割取西奈、德拉、苏韦达：无论被埃及/叙利亚还是叛军实体占领，只要不在以色列手里就转移
				if = {
					limit = { 213 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					213 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 184 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					184 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 185 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					185 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				# 幼发拉底河以西的其余叙利亚州（与 B-5 清单一致）
				if = {
					limit = { 186 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					186 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 571 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					571 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 188 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					188 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 189 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					189 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 190 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					190 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 566 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					566 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 575 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					575 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 561 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					561 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 191 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					191 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 994 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					994 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 192 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ISR } } }
					192 = {
						transfer_state_to = ISR
					}
				}
				# 诉求州补核心（原版效果 add_state_core = <州号>）
				ISR = {
					add_state_core = 209
					add_state_core = 208
					add_state_core = 213
					add_state_core = 210
					add_state_core = 211
					add_state_core = 212
					add_state_core = 184
					add_state_core = 185
					add_state_core = 186
					add_state_core = 571
					add_state_core = 188
					add_state_core = 189
					add_state_core = 190
					add_state_core = 566
					add_state_core = 575
					add_state_core = 561
					add_state_core = 191
					add_state_core = 994
					add_state_core = 192
				}
				# 吞并残余实体（白和已在上方完成，避免“白和后国家消失导致州无人接管”）
				if = {
					limit = {
						country_exists = PAL
						PAL = { has_country_flag = MEW_belligerent }
					}
					ISR = {
						annex_country = {
							target = PAL
							transfer_troops = no
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						country_exists = HAM
						HAM = { has_country_flag = MEW_belligerent }
					}
					ISR = {
						annex_country = {
							target = HAM
							transfer_troops = no
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						country_exists = HEZ
						HEZ = { has_country_flag = MEW_belligerent }
					}
					ISR = {
						annex_country = {
							target = HEZ
							transfer_troops = no
						}
					}
				}
				# 清理约旦残余：210/211/212 已在上方转入以色列，这里收掉无地残骸
				if = {
					limit = {
						country_exists = JOR
					}
					ISR = {
						annex_country = {
							target = JOR
							transfer_troops = no
						}
					}
				}
				set_global_flag = skip_default_capitulation
				clr_global_flag = MEW_sixth_war_ongoing
				set_global_flag = MEW_israel_victory
				news_event = { id = mew.20 }
				news_event = { id = mew.21 days = 5 }
				# 白和已在终局开头（① 步骤）对全部 MEW 参战方一次性执行，此处不再重复调用；
				# 顺序原因：先白和收束战争 → 再按诉求清单转州 → 再补核心 → 最后吞并残余实体，
				# 避免「白和后国家消失导致州无人接管」的中间态
				# 以色列胜利后进入东进阶段：撕毁停火，进军大马士革与幼发拉底河
				ISR = {
					country_event = { id = mew.22 days = 7 }
				}
				# 第三阶段：东进 90 天后由美国背书对伊朗开战（原派发点在内战蓝方胜利事件，已停用）
				country_event = { id = mew.30 days = 90 }
				# 幂等锁：终局结算只执行一次，重复进入不得二次转州
				set_global_flag = MEW_settlement_done
			}
		}
	}

	# ===== 反伊战争僵持兜底（on_monthly，不逐日扫描）=====
	# 540 天（18 个月）取自 MEW 节奏：主战争倒计时为 700 天，东进阶段只有 55 天，
	# 反伊战争在以色列赢下黎凡特并完成东进后才开启，属于决定性空袭+地面打击，
	# 18 个月足够分出胜负，同时短于主战争的 700 天，避免整条链被一场僵持拖死。
	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					original_tag = ISR
					has_global_flag = MEW_iran_war_ongoing
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = MEW_iran_war_timeout
					}
				}
				# 白和收束：对所有仍与伊朗交战的国家白和（含被阵营拉入的盟友）；
				# 只结束与伊朗之间的战争，不影响任何一方的其他战争
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						has_war_with = PER
					}
					white_peace = PER
				}
				# 清理战争状态：本链路没有给敌方加任何临时修正，只需撤掉进行中旗标；
				# 保留 MEW_iran_war_declared 与 mew.30 的 fire_only_once，杜绝重复宣战
				clr_global_flag = MEW_iran_war_ongoing
				clr_country_flag = MEW_iran_war_timeout
			}
			# ===== 伊拉克战争僵持兜底（同一 on_monthly，不逐日扫描）=====
			# 270 天取自 MEW 节奏：主战争 700 天、伊朗战争 540 天；伊拉克战争发生在东进之后，
			# 对手是已被阿拉伯联军战争打残的伊拉克，目标只是幼发拉底河 7 州，
			# 9 个月足够打完这场收尾战，也避免整条链再被拖满一年。
			if = {
				limit = {
					original_tag = ISR
					has_global_flag = MEW_iraq_war_ongoing
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_war_with = IRQ
						}
					}
					# 伊拉克已投降或以其他方式停战：只撤旗标，不再触发白和，避免留下“战争中”残留
					clr_global_flag = MEW_iraq_war_ongoing
					clr_country_flag = MEW_iraq_war_timeout
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_country_flag = MEW_iraq_war_timeout
						}
					}
					# 白和收束：以色列及其盟友与伊拉克停战，不影响各方对第三国的战争
					every_country = {
						limit = {
							has_war_with = IRQ
							OR = {
								tag = ISR
								is_in_faction_with = ISR
							}
						}
						white_peace = IRQ
					}
					clr_global_flag = MEW_iraq_war_ongoing
					clr_country_flag = MEW_iraq_war_timeout
				}
			}
			# ===== 上合闸门月度兜底：三胜齐备后自动走既有邀请入口（同一 on_monthly，不逐日扫描）=====
			if = {
				limit = {
					original_tag = EGY
					has_global_flag = MEW_palestine_victory
				}
				ZZZ_MEW_auto_invite_egypt_sco = yes
				ZZZ_MEW_post_eurasia_uar_war = yes
			}
			# ===== 泛阿拉伯同盟对海湾君主国战争僵持兜底（同一 on_monthly，不逐日扫描）=====
			# 540 天取自反伊战争口径：中俄胜利后开打的统一战争没有第三方调停，
			# 18 个月足够分出胜负；超时按现有 ZZZ_UAR_resolve_war_outcome 白和收束。
			if = {
				limit = {
					original_tag = EGY
					has_global_flag = ZZZ_UAR_war_on_monarchies
					NOT = { has_global_flag = ZZZ_UAR_war_over }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = ZZZ_MEW_uar_war_timeout }
				}
				ZZZ_UAR_resolve_war_outcome = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
